== Strategy ==

Get Incom engineer out on your first turn. He adds 2 to destiny in battle where you have a t-47. Tauntaun handlers now add a destiny. Power Harpoon can take out an AT-AT pretty quick. Use the Don’t Do That Again shield to get Heroic Sacrifice out on your first turn to keep those pesky maintainance cards at bay.

Most importantly use the shield. Don’t fight unless you have to. The objective in this desk can really mess your oppenent up when you start making them lose force for simply having t-47’s out. The reacting ability of your t-47 can also be very lethal.
